comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Owns and runs physical billboards and transit displays; Taboola places digital content recommendations and native ads on publisher sites.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mobile app preloading, distribution and user acquisition; shares ad-tech overlap but not Taboola's publisher content recommendation model.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Measures and verifies ad quality as software; does not sell or place ads or share revenue with publishers.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Consumer social networking and dating app earning subscriptions; advertising is secondary, not a content recommendation business.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Owns consumer lifestyle media brands and sells ads on its own sites; Taboola places ads on third-party publishers' sites.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Owns and sells outdoor billboard and transit display space; no digital content recommendation or native ad technology.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Full-service marketing agency network with creative and PR work; Taboola sells its own platform rather than agency services.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Publishes sports and lifestyle websites and magazines, selling its own audience; Taboola is a platform across third-party publishers.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Diversified media brands plus cybersecurity and speed-test software; lacks Taboola's recommendation and native advertising platform.
